t: This is Shepherd's Well, a detached house at 5 Frognal Way in Frognal. It was built between 1929 and 1930, and the architect Adrian Gilbert Scott designed it as his own home. Scott was an English ecclesiastical architect, so it's a little unusual to see him working on a house for himself rather than a church. The building has been Grade II listed on the National Heritage List for England since January 1999.
